verdict.rationale: Aider ships several fixed event-triggered behaviors: `--watch-files` acts when a saved file contains `AI!` or `AI?` comments, `--auto-test` with `--test-cmd` runs tests after each AI edit, and linting and git commits happen automatically on edits. Community users confirm watch mode works. However, these are predefined hooks configured through switches or `.aider.conf.yml`, not a general engine where users write their own event-to-action rules. Missing for 10: user-defined arbitrary trigger/action rules, events beyond file saves and AI edits (e.g., CI, issues, schedules), and hooks for custom actions.
